correctness.rationale: Tracing retained swap-branch tuples (original index, threshold, random, flag=1) makes those contributions mutually orthogonal. The unswapped tuples (alias, threshold, random, flag=0) coincide exactly for matching alias and threshold, yielding the exact positive Gram sum. Strict b-bit storage makes every exchanged-branch coefficient B-t_j positive, enforcing all aliases equal for rank one, and t_j=0 away from the common address. Uniform diagonals give d_i=sum_{j:a_j=i}d_j>0; every label has a preimage, so the alias map is a permutation and deficits/thresholds are constant on its cycles. The resulting reduced state is I/L, whose fidelity, trace distance, and entropy follow from its exact eigenvalues. All quantifiers are proved symbolically.

originality.rationale: The 2018 source already supplies a full garbage-state amplitude description and the 2026 anchor knows the diagonal marginals and retained garbage, so neither fact is newly claimed. The novel statement is a complete all-tables finite-bit rank-one iff classification and exact-uniform iff-permutation classification, with sharp maximal-mixing and fidelity consequences; none of the checked primary texts or targeted semantic results state or dominate that theorem. A possible unindexed corollary of the full Babbush formula remains an explicitly acknowledged residual risk.
residual_risks: The full 2018 garbage-state equation implies the reduced Gram structure after a partial trace; an old unindexed note might have already extracted the all-table conclusions.
The exact rigidity relies on storing t_j as a b-bit integer strictly below 2^b. Circuits that encode a full-keep value or clean their ancillas can evade the stated conclusions.
No claim about the difficulty or optimal cost of garbage cleanup or the fidelity of the full oracle is made.

value.rationale: An exact every-table classification is a natural diagnostic for a circuit family whose source explicitly distinguishes sampled probability fidelity from pure-state fidelity and reports resource benchmarks. It shows not just one example but that absolutely every exact-uniform output under the actual finite-bit compare/swap implementation is maximally mixed and n ebits entangled with retained data, despite perfect sampled probabilities. The exact pure-output classification also identifies all exceptions (basis states) and a sharp role for finite-precision threshold encoding. This is an operationally motivated coherence boundary, not an arbitrary numerical slice or simple normalization check.
